name: macos-notify
description: Post a macOS notification, so a run can say how it went with the window closed

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: The body. A whole ${node.result} is fine — it is trimmed to what a banner shows

inputs.name: sound
inputs.description: A name from /System/Library/Sounds, e.g. Basso or Glass. Empty is silent

outputs.name: shown
outputs.description: The body as it was actually displayed, after collapsing and trimming

outputs.name: truncated
outputs.description: "true" when the message was longer than a banner holds
